### Peptide Spotlight: Semaglutide and the GLP-1 Class
Semaglutide is a glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist with an extended half-life of approximately one week. It works by stimulating insulin secretion, inhibiting glucagon, slowing gastric emptying, and reducing appetite.
